description: This file is a test class for the AccessFlowStateMachineDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests to verify the functionality of methods related to workflow state transitions, role-based access, and state machine retrieval, primarily for the human resource management system.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the AccessFlowStateMachineDao within the OrangeHRM system, containing unit tests for workflow state machine operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForExistingAction
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed actions for a valid existing action in the workflow.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForNonExistingAction
methods.description: Tests behavior when retrieving allowed actions for a non-existing action.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForExistingState
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the next state given an existing current state.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForInvalidState
methods.description: Checks handling when querying next state for an invalid current state.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Tests fetching states that are actionable based on role and actions.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Verifies saving a new workflow state machine record and its properties.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion of a workflow state machine record.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Tests retrieval of workflow records for a specific workflow.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsNullWorkflow
methods.description: Checks handling when no records exist for a given workflow.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if an action is permitted for a specific role and state.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedForNonEntry
methods.description: Tests permission check when the current state is not an entry point.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsExisting
methods.description: Checks allowed workflow items for a specific state.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsAllStates
methods.description: Verifies fetching all workflow items when state is null.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsNotExisting
methods.description: Tests for no workflow items found for a non-existing state.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of workflow item by multiple criteria.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Tests deletion of workflow records for a specific role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRoleAllWorkflows
methods.description: Tests deletion of workflow records for a role across all workflows.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Verifies handling of role name change in workflow records.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemIdsForRole
methods.description: Helper method to fetch workflow item IDs for a role in a specific workflow context.
